failure: Intervention and outcome consequences enter features.
invalid_plan: Use post-maintenance sensor signatures to predict the preceding failure.
repair: Bind feature availability to prediction origin and model intervention/censoring.

failure: The same counterparty and future cycle information leak across partitions.
invalid_plan: Randomly split facility-month rows for a counterparty target.
repair: Group by counterparty and use out-of-time evaluation with label-maturity lag.

failure: Predictive evaluation cannot prove exchangeability, positivity, consistency or interference assumptions.
invalid_plan: Select the best treatment-effect predictor by test error and claim causal effect.
repair: Reference an authorized study/causal identification artifact and run sensitivity/refutation checks.

failure: Finite-sample marginal coverage assumptions and scope were strengthened.
invalid_plan: Promise per-case coverage under arbitrary deployment shift from an IID split-conformal result.
repair: Bind exchangeability/shift model, score, calibration window, group policy and monitoring.

failure: Recorded/available time violates the observation cutoff.
invalid_plan: Use chart values recorded after deterioration but backdated to clinical time.
repair: Point-in-time feature join on actual availability and external site validation.

failure: Many-to-many object interactions, relationship qualifiers and temporal state are duplicated or lost.
invalid_plan: Flatten every object-centric event to one order case and call it lossless.
repair: Retain OCEL/OCED graph, bind a declared case projection, or use HOEG/tEKG/state-aware representation under qualification.
